audit.whatIsWrong: diff reads HARD but diffRating is 6/10 and the Final Matchup Rating line says 'Even matchup'. The win rate is 42.13% over 731 games — the worst lane in this champion's list.
audit.why: A 42% lane cannot be labelled even anywhere on the page, and 6/10 understates it next to matchups rated the same that Malphite wins.
audit.corrected: HARD, 8/10, with Level 6 the only Malphite stage on the chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 spike is written as an unconditional 'one real window' with no mention of the ability that cancels it, and no cooldown appears anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100s and is a dash. Mega Adhesive is 17/16/15/14/13s at 1000 range and grounds. Fling is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s. Insanity Potion is 100s.
audit.corrected: Level 6 is your window only when Mega Adhesive is not already on the ground between you.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in the matchup is stated backwards. The page says 'R is the one thing in your kit that beats his W fling and his move speed — it's unstoppable'. Mega Adhesive IS the W, it grounds, and Unstoppable Force is a dash — the goo denies your ultimate outright. Fling is E, not W, and the page calls it 'his W fling' four times.
audit.why: Riot text, Mega Adhesive: 'Throws a vial of mega adhesive on the ground, slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it.' Malphite's Unstoppable Force: 'launches himself to a location at high speed' — the kit file flags it dash. Fling: 'Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed. If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.'
audit.corrected: Mega Adhesive grounds you, so R will not fire from the goo — engage before it lands or from ground he has not covered. And Fling into Mega Adhesive is a root, not just a slow.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.late and the Itemization line both call anti-heal core because 'his healing fights your grind'.
audit.why: Singed has no heal in his kit — no ability carries a heal flag, and Insanity Potion grants combat stats plus Grievous Wounds on his own poison. Grievous Wounds buys nothing against him; the relevant fact is that HIS ultimate applies Grievous Wounds to you.
audit.corrected: Dropped the anti-heal claim from the late breakdown in favour of the interaction that decides fights.

edits.before: Forget trading — Singed doesn't auto-attack you, so your E attack-speed slow and W armor splash are dead weight here, and your armor stacking means nothing against his poison's magic damage. He'll walk up, W-fling you into his trail, and stroll off while it ticks. Your only tool is Q: land it to steal his move speed and deny the fling, then back off. Do NOT chase him into his poison or under his proxy — that's exactly how he wants the lane to play.
edits.after: Forget trading — Singed doesn't auto-attack you, so Ground Slam's attack-speed slow is dead weight and armour does nothing against Poison Trail's magic damage. He walks up, Flings you (E, 10s at rank 1) into the trail, and strolls off while it ticks. Worse: if the Fling drops you onto Mega Adhesive (W) you are rooted, not merely slowed. Your only tool is Seismic Shard — steal his move speed, then back off. Never chase into the poison.

edits.before: Level 6 is your single window. R is the one thing in your kit that beats his W fling and his move speed — it's unstoppable and knocks him up, so use it to interrupt a fling or to lock him for a jungler gank, never to chase him in lane. Without a collapse you can't kill him solo: his sustain and Phase Rush mean a 1v1 just ends with you flung and poisoned. Q to stick, R to pin, and only commit when you have help.
edits.after: Level 6 is your single window, and here is its counter: Mega Adhesive (W, 17s at rank 1) grounds anyone standing on it, and Unstoppable Force is a dash — lay in the goo and your R simply does not fire. Engage before the W lands, or from ground he has not covered, then knock him up for a jungler collapse. Solo you do not kill him; a 1v1 ends with you flung, rooted and poisoned. Q to stick, R only with help.

edits.before: This stays miserable. Singed flings your backline into his team and your telegraphed R dash is easy for him to see and outrun with his move speed and W. Your armor does nothing against his poison, so you can't out-durable him the way you out-trade AD bruisers. Your job becomes peeling — body-block his fling on your carries and save R to displace him off them, not to engage. Don't try to win the sidelane; he proxies faster than you can ever catch him.
edits.after: This stays miserable. Singed flings your backline into his team, and Mega Adhesive grounds your R dash outright — a goo carpet across the fight is a hard no on your engage. Armour does nothing against his poison, so you can't out-durable him the way you do AD bruisers. Peel instead: body-block the Fling on your carries and save R to displace him off them. Don't contest the sidelane; he proxies faster than you can catch him.

notes: This page had the matchup's decisive interaction exactly backwards. It told the player 'R is the one thing in your kit that beats his W fling — it's unstoppable', when Singed's W is Mega Adhesive, Mega Adhesive grounds, and Unstoppable Force is a dash: the goo cancels the ultimate the page calls the answer. It also named Fling as W four times when Fling is E, and never mentioned that a Fling landing you inside Mega Adhesive roots rather than slows. Note the asymmetry with the rest of this champion's data — Malphite's own kit file carries 'grounding' flags on Q and E that Riot's descriptions do not support (move-speed steal and attack-speed slow), so Malphite grounds nothing; Singed's W grounding, by contrast, is stated in Riot's text and is real. Also removed: 'anti-heal stays core' from the late breakdown — Singed has no healing in his kit. The Itemization line (report[8].t) still carries 'Add anti-heal (Thornmail component early) — his healing fights your grind', which I left alone because rewriting the whole item string was outside a safe length band; it should be corrected manually. Finally, the full layer labelled a 42.13% lane 'Even matchup' in its final rating while diff read HARD; I aligned both to HARD 8/10.
